From: Ravi Menon, Operations Lead
To: Finance Approval Group
Subject: Budget approval request - annual Asana Premium subscription

Hi team,

I would like to request approval for an annual Asana Premium subscription for
the operations team.

What we are asking for
- Requested budget: $2,400.

Why we need it
- Our team currently tracks tasks manually across spreadsheets and chat
  threads. Based on the last two months of logging this consumes approximately
  12 hours per week for the team.
- We estimate a 35% reduction in manual processing time once task tracking is
  centralised in a single tool.
- Asana lists Slack and Google Workspace integrations, and we already use
  both, so adoption should be low friction.

Rollout
- The vendor has confirmed onboarding within four business days of approval.

What I could not confirm
- A vendor pricing sheet is mentioned in their proposal, but I have not
  copied its contents into this email and I cannot vouch for the tiers.
- I have deliberately not included a per-user subscription price or an exact
  annual subscription total, because the figures I was given did not
  reconcile with the $2,400 I am requesting.
- I have not been able to establish what our loaded labour cost is, so I am
  not attaching a savings calculation.

Decision requested
- Please approve the $2,400 budget request so we can begin onboarding.

Thanks,
Ravi
